text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF CANCER OF THE CERVIX
Clinical Features
May be asymptomatic. (Picked up in the early stage by routine PAP smear screening)
Abnormal vaginal bleeding: Post-coital, Contact, Spontaneous or Inter-menstrual
Anaemia is a common feature of advanced cases.
Post-menopausal Vaginal discharge. In advanced disease, the discharge is offensive. Pyometria with uterine enlargement may also occur
Haemorrhagic, ulcerative or fungating lesion on the cervix, with extension to the vagina wall in advanced stages.
Vesico-vaginal fistula and/or recto-vaginal fistula in advanced stages
